messages.subject: ODE solving with vectors
parts:
I'm trying to solve a model based on a ODE. However, in order to make my ODE work within stan, everything is being calculated using vectors. When I attempt to compile, I get the following error: 
stan/lib/stan_math/stan/math/prim/arr/functor/coupled_ode_system.hpp:98:15: error: no match for ‘operator=’ (operand types are ‘std::vector<double>’ and ‘Eigen::Matrix<double, -1, 1>’)
         dy_dt = f_(t, y, theta_dbl_, x_, x_int_, msgs_);
               ^
In file included from /usr/include/c++/5/vector:69:0,
                 from stan/lib/stan_math/stan/math/memory/stack_alloc.hpp:12,
                 from stan/lib/stan_math/stan/math/rev/core/autodiffstackstorage.hpp:4,
                 from stan/lib/stan_math/stan/math/rev/core.hpp:4,
                 from stan/lib/stan_math/stan/math/rev/mat.hpp:4,
                 from stan/lib/stan_math/stan/math.hpp:4,
                 from stan/src/stan/model/model_header.hpp:4,
                 from ./examples/platelets/platelets.hpp:3,
                 from <command-line>:0:
/usr/include/c++/5/bits/vector.tcc:167:5: note: candidate: std::vector<_Tp, _Alloc>& std::vector<_Tp, _Alloc>::operator=(const std::vector<_Tp, _Alloc>&) [with _Tp = double; _Alloc = std::allocator<double>]
     vector<_Tp, _Alloc>::
     ^
/usr/include/c++/5/bits/vector.tcc:167:5: note:   no known conversion for argument 1 from ‘Eigen::Matrix<double, -1, 1>’ to ‘const std::vector<double>&’
make/models:10: recipe for target 'examples/platelets/platelets' failed"

I interpret this error that I can't return a vector to use with stan's ODE solvers. If so, is there a way to convert a vector into an acceptable data type, or should I just rewrite the model using different data types?

messages.subject: Re: [stan-users] ODE solving with vectors
parts:
It always helps to include your Stan code, otherwise we have
to guess. See below for guess.

> On Mar 21, 2017, at 9:14 AM, Rachel L <space...@gmail.com> wrote:
>

> I'm trying to solve a model based on a ODE. However, in order to make my ODE work within stan, everything is being calculated using vectors. When I attempt to compile, I get the following error:
> stan/lib/stan_math/stan/math/prim/arr/functor/coupled_ode_system.hpp:98:15: error: no match for ‘operator=’ (operand types are ‘std::vector<double>’ and ‘Eigen::Matrix<double, -1, 1>’)
> dy_dt = f_(t, y, theta_dbl_, x_, x_int_, msgs_);
> ^
> In file included from /usr/include/c++/5/vector:69:0,
> from stan/lib/stan_math/stan/math/memory/stack_alloc.hpp:12,
> from stan/lib/stan_math/stan/math/rev/core/autodiffstackstorage.hpp:4,
> from stan/lib/stan_math/stan/math/rev/core.hpp:4,
> from stan/lib/stan_math/stan/math/rev/mat.hpp:4,
> from stan/lib/stan_math/stan/math.hpp:4,
> from stan/src/stan/model/model_header.hpp:4,
> from ./examples/platelets/platelets.hpp:3,
> from <command-line>:0:
> /usr/include/c++/5/bits/vector.tcc:167:5: note: candidate: std::vector<_Tp, _Alloc>& std::vector<_Tp, _Alloc>::operator=(const std::vector<_Tp, _Alloc>&) [with _Tp = double; _Alloc = std::allocator<double>]
> vector<_Tp, _Alloc>::
> ^
> /usr/include/c++/5/bits/vector.tcc:167:5: note: no known conversion for argument 1 from ‘Eigen::Matrix<double, -1, 1>’ to ‘const std::vector<double>&’

You're trying to assign a vector type in Stan to something
that requires a real[] (array of reals). They're not the same
and there's a chapter in the manual outlining the differences.

- Bob

messages.subject: Re: [stan-users] ODE solving with vectors
parts:
Thanks. The problem is that the ODE function has to be defined
as an array of reals, not a vector. If you change

“vector Balances” to “real[] Balances”

and

“vector[11] dxdd” to "real dxdt[11]”

and then change Line 156 to a loop then it compiles correctly.

Bob — we should be able to check for this type mismatch in the parser,
no?
